video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Tim MacMahon On Cooper Flagg’s Limitless Potential, Kyrie’s Return Expectations & More

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg's potential as a primary scorer in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I'm not going to be a guy who puts any kind of limitations on Cooper Flagg.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to be a guy who puts any kind of limitations on Cooper Flagg. Coming into the league, probably as much hype as an American prospect since LeBron James. Talking to people midway through last season, talking to executives and scouts from other teams, the consensus was this guy is not just living up to the hype, but exceeding the hype. There was a question, hey, he can impact the game in so many different ways, and that versatility was what made him so special as a prospect, but can he ever be a primary scorer? He answers that question before his 19th birthday on a team that didn't have a lot of playmaking, that didn't have any spacing.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Cooper Flagg's rookie potential to Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: There's always going to be the natural comparisons to Luka Doncic, just very different players.
quotes.quote: There's always going to be the natural comparisons to Luka Doncic, just very different players with similar levels of talent. Luka was an All-NBA player his second season, and I don't think that's out of the realm of possibilities whatsoever for Cooper this year.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's recovery and expectations for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: The expectation is Kyrie is going to look like Kyrie.
quotes.quote: The expectation is Kyrie is going to look like Kyrie. Obviously, it's been a year and a half plus of a recovery and ramp-up process. He's still going to have to ramp up to regular season intensity, but the expectation is he's going to be one of the most skilled guards in the league just like he has been throughout his career.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Dallas Mavericks' willingness to entertain trade discussions for Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: There's a lot of intrigue around the league as far as whether the Mavericks will be willing.
quotes.quote: There's a lot of intrigue around the league as far as whether the Mavericks will be willing to entertain trade discussions for Kyrie. It's not because the Mavericks don't love Kyrie, they absolutely do, but the charge from Nico Harrison is to build a sustainable contender around Cooper Flagg. Could a path forward, or at least part of a path forward, be capitalized on the value that Kyrie would have in the trade market?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's role in complementing Cooper Flagg's development
quotes.excerpt: From a pure basketball perspective, Kyrie really does compliment and enhance Cooper.
quotes.quote: From a pure basketball perspective, Kyrie really does compliment and enhance Cooper. Cooper obviously can play on the ball, but you don't want him to have the majority of those responsibilities. Kyrie can initiate the offense, Kyrie can play off of the star. We've seen that with LeBron James, with Kevin Durant, with Luka Doncic. He thrives in that co-star type of role and I do think there's some real benefit if this is a season where the Mavericks take a significant step forward.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Uncertainty surrounding Derek Lively II's health and center rotation
quotes.excerpt: I'm very curious to see what the center rotation looks like.
quotes.quote: I'm very curious to see what the center rotation looks like. Unfortunately, I don't know when we'll be able to see Derek Lively II in game action again. Huge year for him though, last year of his contract, unfortunately significant questions about his future just purely because of the health perspective.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Expectations for O-Max Prosper's role in the Mavericks' rotation
quotes.excerpt: I'm honestly fascinated to see how much O-Max Prosper is playing at the five this year.
quotes.quote: I'm honestly fascinated to see how much O-Max Prosper is playing at the five this year. I've heard him compared a lot to Bam Adebayo. He's not a seven-footer, but he's a big strong kid who isn't afraid to mix it up in the paint, so curious to see how he fits in the roster this year and as a foundation piece for the future.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Mavericks' potential to compete for a play-in spot
quotes.excerpt: A successful step forward this year for the Mavericks would be at least competing for a play-in.
quotes.quote: A successful step forward this year for the Mavericks would be at least competing for a play-in bid down the stretch if not a playoff spot, and feeling like going into next summer that there are multiple young guys on the roster that you see as part of a core moving forward. Cooper Flagg, no question. Certainly, they wouldn't have picked O-Max Prosper number nine if they didn't strongly believe that.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the development of Zaccharie Risacher and Max Christie
quotes.excerpt: Let's see what Zaccharie Risacher can do in kind of a second opportunity, a second chance for him.
quotes.quote: Let's see what Zaccharie Risacher can do in kind of a second opportunity, a second chance for him. Let's see what kind of a season Max Christie has in a contract year. Sergio De La Rey as a first-round pick, I don't know how much he'll play, but let's see if he can kind of prove and sell himself as a core piece.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Moving on from the Luka Doncic trade era
quotes.excerpt: There's no point in having the rearview mirror on the Luka trade.
quotes.quote: There's no point in having the rearview mirror on the Luka trade. That thing is done, it was a disaster, it was historically dumb. But nothing that you can say about that is going to impact the future. You've got a future here with Cooper Flagg. It's the front office's job to build a sustainable contender around him.
